prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-05):
Price action as of 2026-02-05: 1w +10.7%, 1m +9.7%, 3m +17.7%. Last close 283.50. 21d annualized realized volatility 31%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 94% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has delivered unusually strong short-term momentum (double-digit gains over 1w/1m) yet sits at the extreme upper end of its trailing 63-day range, leaving little technical headroom and raising the odds of mean-reversion or consolidation over the next 20 trading days. Realized volatility of 31% further supports the likelihood of chop rather than continued linear upside.  
DECISION: SELL
